scope: Internal approval to scale the corrected-source pilot only; not release approval or a guarantee of all-row semantic correctness
observations: Both sampled questions now present chronological history followed by the explicit current user request. Raw dialogue reconstruction previously passed for all 21,451 source tasks.

PLUS-loan sample: every substantive final-answer claim is present in the expanded source: supplemental information, selected school, eligibility/application processing, MPN, optional educational charges, parent payment/deferment choices and credit-freeze restriction. Answer is verbose but grounded and addresses the current form-definition question.

Inspected full tool bodies, native arguments, task system and final responses for both samples. All 21 accepted pilot rows passed independent assistant-label and exact-expansion audits: 35 calls, 10 multi-expansion traces, minimum segment length 606 Qwen tokens.

Conservative whole-document support coverage can cause unnecessary additional expansions; multiple calls are not necessarily evidence of multi-hop reasoning. No claim of improved accuracy versus the original pilot is made.
